watchOS 27.2 will be released next month, bringing multiple new Apple Watch features, and leaker pdfu has also discovered major changes coming to the screenshot function.

The new screenshot experience in watchOS 27.2 code borrows from the iPhone

Leaker pdfu has recently begun sharing multiple details discovered in Apple code. For example, he was the first person to discover the Readiness app in watchOS 27, and yesterday he exclusively leaked the Siri AI interface on HomePod.

In a new article today, pdfu revealed that the watchOS 27.2 beta contains code related to a redesigned screenshot experience for Apple Watch.

Currently, taking a screenshot on Apple Watch only causes the screen to flash, and then the screenshot is added to your photo library.

The new screenshot flow mimics the current approach on iPhone and iPad, allowing you to immediately choose to share and/or delete the screenshot.

It is currently unclear whether Apple plans to add this change in the upcoming watchOS 27.2 beta, or whether it still needs more time to develop. However, if it ultimately doesn't make it into watchOS 27.2, there is still a good chance we will see this feature on Apple Watch in the near future.

What do you think of the new screenshot experience leaked in watchOS 27.2? Feel free to let us know in the comment section.
